rights: PD or CC BY individually checked; images are not generated.
scalePolicy: Scale bars measured in the exact downloaded representation. Approximate physical pixel sampling; no scale inferred from objective magnification alone.
reproducibility: Scratch repack_fix.py, data/fix-download-urls.json and original raw photographs. All crops and masks in fix-cuts.json. Round 2: Scratch r2_material.py and r2-cuts.json; r2-gather.json preserves new raw-source metadata.
gathering: Started 2026-11-05 23:42:14 UTC. Initial accepted photographic package packed by 00:18 UTC. Last bounded network attempts were near 2026-11-06T00:29:14.093613+00:00; three additional pond photographs returned 403 and were omitted. Network gathering remained within the owner-authorized 75 minute cap; later local crop, scale and rendering checks are documented separately.
exclusions: PLOS PMC5484483: numerical label but no drawn scale span; implausible implied anatomy.
PMC5201266 iodine panels: internally implausible stated 2 µm scale, not silently corrected.
Unscaled Commons cheek/onion/crystal photos and incompatible NC/ND/SA sources excluded.
assembly: Pond photographic specimens are reused at unchanged physical scales across a larger stage. Their counts, positions and paths are a model, not measured natural abundance. Root and onion fields are separate photographs, not a contiguous tissue reconstruction.
